title: Mulugu District Recruitment 2026 - Apply Offline for 07 Pharmacist, Yoga Professional and Other Posts
description: Mulugu District has issued an official notification for the recruitment of 07 Ayush Medical Officers, Pharmacists, Yoga Professionals, and Psychosocial Counselors. Candidates who have qualified with any degree, post-graduation, B.Pharm, D. Pharm, or BAMS can grab this chance and apply for the Mulugu District Recruitment 2026 . Here we have included the age limit, selection process, salary structure, education details, application fee, and how to apply for these posts. Interested and eligible ...
